severity_basis.statement: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed
Neighbours say some residents may still be inside
No image was available to corroborate or contradict the extent of the collapse

main_risks.risk: Primary structural collapse is already occurring with potential victims trapped inside.
main_risks.basis: Report of partial collapse of a five-storey building and indications that residents may be inside.

main_risks.risk: Secondary collapse of the remaining structure.
main_risks.basis: The building has already partially collapsed, making the residual structure unstable.

main_risks.risk: Harm to individuals in adjacent structures or on the street due to falling debris or dust.
main_risks.basis: Report indicates dust covers the street and the building is five storeys high.

main_risks.risk: Utility-related hazards such as gas leaks or electrocution.
main_risks.basis: Missing information includes the status of gas and electricity utilities at the site.

possibly_affected.element: Residents of the five-storey apartment building
The structural integrity of the remaining portion of the building
The street where the dust has accumulated

conflicts_between_sources: No direct conflicts between report and image data, as the image was not analyzable.

considerations.text: For a building that has collapsed or is partially collapsed, responders may consider whether the building has been posted UNSAFE based on rapid evaluation actions.
If the investigation reveals hazards such as a broken gas line, responders may consider whether the building is posted UNSAFE and if the area is barricated.
Responders may consider whether undamaged buildings adjacent to the damaged one need to be posted UNSAFE or RESTRICTED USE due to exposure to hazards from the collapse.

When establishing perimeter control, responders may consider whether a collapse shadow cordon is shaped as a wedge or limited rectangle in the direction the building may fall, to reduce impact on recovery operations.

uncertainties: The exact scale of the collapse is not visible due to image analysis failure.
It is unconfirmed whether there are casualties or trapped residents.
The cause of the collapse is unknown.
information_needed: Number of residents potentially trapped or injured
Whether emergency rescue teams are on scene
Extremities of damage to adjacent structures
Status of utilities (gas, electricity) at the site
